requirements.normative_requirement: The model-visible schemas and names of covered Pi standard tools remain stable.
requirements.primary_verification: Differential corpus against pinned Pi built-ins.

requirements.normative_requirement: Each standard tool has one normative execution path, lock class, deadline, output cap, and generation rule.
User ! shell commands use the same bounded arbitrary-process path as bash.
Host absolute paths are translated only when beneath the source root; every other host absolute path is rejected.
requirements.primary_verification: Property tests for relative, absolute, traversal, symlink, Unicode, and prefix-collision paths.

requirements.normative_requirement: Conflicting standard-tool owners, including snapshot-edit overrides, cause explicit activation failure until a reviewed composition seam exists.
requirements.primary_verification: Load-order matrix with built-ins, snapshot-edit, and another override.
